comparison.objective: Insert and seat an oil-feed sleeve while registering its radial port.
comparison.physical_skill: Precision cylindrical insertion with axial seating and rotational port alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Released supported seating and an unobstructed gauge path must persist for 1 second under tight pose, drift, and contact limits.
comparison.reason: Both need precise insertion, but sleeve assembly tests final bore/port registration; it has no latch depression, maintained extraction-tool engagement, or wire-side pull.
